anchor.quote: Tarot is not cosmology. It is a compression algorithm. Seventy-eight cards encode the full probability distribution of human states under constraint. The Three of Wands appears when the first-order effects of a prior choice become visible — when the Ba's trajectory intersects with the field's feedback. Not because the universe is responding, but because causal chains have length, and we are slow to perceive our own outputs.

claims.rationale: Tarot, compression algorithms, and probability distributions are equated without an encoding, sample space, probability measure, transformation, or declared Noesis synthesis.

legacy.quote: "It is a compression algorithm… the full probability distribution of human states"
legacy.note: Info-theory name-drop stated as identity (no "like"); no encoding or distribution shown; argument survives removal.

anchor.quote: The alchemical stage of Citrinitas — the solar integration of methodology, the transmutation of silver into gold — maps precisely onto this moment. The ships returning are not the end of the Work. They are the evidence that the Work has reached a phase where its products are visible from the origin point. Nigredo was the departure: the calcination of the old identity in the fires of Samui. Albedo was the lunar revelation: the recognition, in darkness, that the old self was already ash. Citrinitas is the solar return — the body now carrying a new frequency, the observer now reading a new signal, the resistance still present but now recognized as sculpting material rather than obstacle.

claims.rationale: The paragraph explicitly adapts Nigredo, Albedo, and Citrinitas as the essay's alchemical house reading and consistently defines each stage inside that frame.

legacy.quote: "Citrinitas — the solar integration of methodology… maps precisely onto this moment"
legacy.note: Alchemical stage sequence (Nigredo→Albedo→Citrinitas) is house cosmology by definition.

anchor.quote: But Bangkok is also a signal processor. Seventeen million people, each carrying their own Kha-Ba-La triad, generating interference patterns at every intersection. The street vendor at Soi 23 who remembers my order. The tuk-tuk driver who quotes a price, waits, quotes another. The hotel staff who do not ask why I stay six weeks. Each is a node in a network that does not know my name but encodes my pattern. Kha declares presence through movement and timing; Ba carries it through gesture and respiration; La sculpts it through the resistance of language barriers, currency conversions, thermal load.

claims.rationale: A population estimate, network metaphor, and Kha-Ba-La civic mapping are combined without separate traces or declared Noesis authorship; the seventeen-million figure is nonconsequential and unsourced.

legacy.quote: "Seventeen million people… generating interference patterns at every intersection"
legacy.note: House signal-field grammar; population figure a plausible Bangkok metro estimate, not a cited stat.

anchor.quote: This is the vijñānamaya kosha operating at civic scale — the wisdom body not as personal intuition but as pattern recognition across populations. The Three of Wands is not mystical here. It is a signal-to-noise problem: can the observer extract the coherent signal from the interference of seventeen million transmitters?

claims.rationale: The vijñānamaya-kosha teaching, civic population model, and signal-to-noise analogy are fused without traced ingredients or declared Noesis transformation; the transmitter count adds unsupported precision.

legacy.quote: "a signal-to-noise problem… the interference of seventeen million transmitters"
legacy.note: House signal grammar paired with vijñānamaya kosha at civic scale.
